def actualPrimeLabelBlockProductSum {ι : Type*} (B : ι → Finset ℕ) :
    List (ι × ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ

        actualPrimeLabelBlockProductSum B blocks (fun r => H (n * r))

mathematical_checks: Original labelled slot word concatenates each repeated-label block. Factorial is the product of those exact block factorials, not the total-slot factorial or later three-group factorials.
BlockProductSum is an explicit recursive finite sum over each complete block product-image. Different vectors with the same full product remain separate summands.

Existing single-label m! coefficient applies only when block product is squarefree. Nonsquarefree n divides r*n, so literal moebius(r*n)=0, before any absolute value or normalization. No equal-prime tuple is dropped by a factorial.
One-block signed identity follows by the existing exact product-fibre grouping; it has no squarefree hypothesis in its conclusion.

Finite induction commutes only finite sums, factors constants, and applies the one-block identity to each block. B supports may overlap, block labels may repeat, r is arbitrary, and H may have either sign.

The normalized full-product fibre theorem retains literal moebius(r*n) and the exact original tuple coefficient on the left, with an exact block-product-vector fibre indicator on the right. It does not assume injectivity of vector-to-full-product.
A fixed original scalar depending on the label word can be included in H; no identity for arbitrary coordinate-dependent weights is asserted.
